mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly federal funds rate increase above 0.5% signals monetary tightening that raises equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 0.5% in one month).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increases in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicate a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of UNRATE decline and PAYEMS increase fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.5%), a decline in unemployment rate signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer confidence and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5% and UNRATE declines.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1000 thousand units in a month, it signals strong consumer demand for housing and related sectors, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months when HOUST > 1000.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average indicates robust supply chain activity and corporate output, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad-based consumer demand across multiple sectors, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of HOUST and RSAFS increases fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: In a low-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL < 2.5%), a decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy that boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL < 2.5% and FEDFUNDS declines.
